label: T
description: The teacher — the adult leading instruction. Usually at the front of the room, near the board, or moving between student desks. Speaks with instructional or directive intent.

label: S
description: An identified student — any student whose face/voice is visible enough to be recognized as a recurring individual within the lesson. When a student is clearly distinguishable, label them S and describe their position or appearance briefly.

label: SN
description: A single unidentified student — a student speaks but cannot be visually attributed to a specific recurring individual (off-camera, brief, ambiguous).

label: SS
description: Multiple students speaking together — choral response, overlapping group talk, or any utterance attributable to two or more students at once.

label: BS
description: Background sound or non-speech vocalization (laughter, classroom noise, brief unintelligible utterance with no clear speaker).
